name: herdr
description: Your herdr sessions in Vaultite: the workspaces and agents of the herdr already running on this machine, each marked working, waiting or idle, in a sidebar panel; open any pane in a tab. Optionally, new terminals start in herdr too, so you can pick them up from herdr in any terminal. Needs herdr (herdr.dev) running; nothing is bundled.
author: Vaultite

newTerminals.label: Start new terminals in herdr
newTerminals.description: new terminals and agents open as tabs in herdr's Vaultite workspace (while herdr runs), so herdr in any terminal reaches them too; off, they run in Vaultite's own

session.label: herdr session
session.description: a named herdr session (herdr --session <name>) instead of the default one
